text:
```yaml
name: Check CLA
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-cla:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Verify CLA text in PR description
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const body = context.payload.pull_request.body || '';
            const requiredText = 'By submitting this pull request, I confirm that you can use, modify, copy, and redistribute this contribution, under the terms of your choice.';
            if (!body.includes(requiredText)) {
              core.setFailed('CLA text not found in PR description.');
            }
```
